remarks: Located in the quiet community of Whitesville, this spacious 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers room to live, work, and entertain both inside and out. The large kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring a center bar area perfect for gathering, along with convenient access to the laundry room, a full bathroom with relaxing soaker tub, and the side porch. Just off the kitchen, you’ll find a generous formal dining room highlighted by a cozy gas fireplace and a versatile main-floor bedroom or office space. The bright living room, filled with natural light, leads to the staircase that welcomes you to the second story. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms await, including a spacious primary bedroom, along with a second full bathroom to accommodate family or guests. The massive, attached garage provides incredible potential for a workshop, hobby space, or storage, complete with multiple overhead doors for easy access. Outside, enjoy summer days in the above-ground pool featuring a deck and slide overlooking the backyard, while the wraparound front porch offers the perfect spot to relax and take in the peaceful surroundings. This property combines charm, functionality, and small-town tranquility ready for you to make it your own!
